title: TACITE : Impact of maintaining tacrolimus after renal transplant failure on access to a retransplantation, a randomized controlled trial
official: TACITE : Impact of maintaining tacrolimus after renal transplant failure on access to a retransplantation, a randomized controlled trial
summary: Main objective: To compare the difficulty to access the graft defined by the rate of hyperimmunized patients on the waiting list for a second kidney transplant, in other words, to demonstrate the efficacy of tacrolimus therapy maintenance compared to immunosuppressive therapy withdrawal at Month 3 to improve the access to a new graft defined by the rate of hyperimmunized patients on the waiting list for a second kidney transplant one year after dialysis onset.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. -	Aged 18 years or older
2. -	Patient with a first kidney transplant failure
3. -	Affiliation with, or beneficiary of a social security (national health insurance)
4. -	Written informed consent obtained from the patients before enrollment
Exclusion criteria:
1. Combined transplantation
2. -	Pregnant or breastfeeding women (a pregnancy test will be performed for women of childbearing potential in accordance with the CTCG guideline (see Appendix 5), and the investigator will ensure that effective contraception is implemented).
3. -	Woman of childbearing potential not using an effective method of contraception (Appendix 5).
4. -	Positive blood pregnancy test in women whose menopausal status cannot be confirmed.
5. -	Patients under tutorship or curatorship or judicial protection
6. 2/ Non randomization exclusion criteria - Patients with a cPRA (or French TGI score) ≥85% known before randomization
7. -	Patients with neoplasia < 2 years except to skin carcinoma (squamous-cell and basal-cell carcinoma)
8. -	History of lymphoma
9. -	KTF in patients with severe or opportunistic infection < 6 months
10. -	Early transplantectomy after renal transplantation (< 3 months)
11. -	Patient with no project of second transplantation
12. -	Patient with a project of living donor < 1 year
13. -	Previous graft failure due to medication nonadherence
14. Hypersensitivity to the active substance (Tacrolimus) or to any of the excipients
